format: 1c's frames (desktopdata/synth.py); train/tsdesk_det.py reads them as an extra source (--extra desk_ui_v2=MANIFEST:ROOT)
fonts: synth3's pool (data/manifests/synth3_fonts.json) without its pixel families, licence class open only (pick_ui_font)
scenes: 1c's scenes (textspot's clean pool, synth2's synthetic backgrounds), cut by VN, screenshot id and sha256 against every protected set

meta_v2: meta attached: [mark index, line index, side, ink gap px]; meta pairs: [line index, label / value ink gap px] (px of the render size); meta mark_kinds: each mark's kind (icon:NAME, badge, leader:KIND, sep:KIND, rule, bracket:KIND, glyph; v1: v1's marks); meta forms: each line's form (run, run2, pair, single, label, value, option, title; null: v1 layouts and the dialogue element)
